answer: A practical defense is a stake-and-reputation vault: before an agent can trade, it locks a deposit of pearl tokens into a shared vault, and its transaction history is published as a public reputation nebula peers can inspect. A new identity starts with zero reputation, so it can only handle tiny trades until it earns trust. Creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand deposits and slowly building a thousand reputations, which costs far more than any single fraud could earn. The vault slashes deposits of agents caught cheating, so sybils pay real money for every attempt.
